card.name: Space just before a dose amount
card.fires_on: The space or small joining word right before a numeric dose such as 20-24 mg, 4 mg or 0.25 mg. It fires when a dose is about to be stated after a drug name, "dose of", or "doses should be".

modes.label: Space after drug name
modes.description: The blank space between a drug name and the dose number that follows it.
modes.example: remained on treatment with iloperidone<< >>20-24 mg/day,

modes.label: Space after dose phrase
modes.description: The space after phrases like "dose of", "should be" or "up to" just before the number.
modes.example: the starting doses should be<< >>0.3 mg given twice a

modes.label: Inside the number
modes.description: The decimal point or a qualifier like "lowest" just before a dose value.

card.writes: It seems to suppress word-start pieces and favor words like "According", so it does little to help predict the dose number.
card.plain: It marks the spot right before a dose amount is written, after a drug name or phrase like "dose of".
